results.title: MY CURRENT EXPERIENCE - GOOD AND BAD - Omi
results.content:
- Form factor - the design with the click is extremely easy to click accidentally and turn off or on. The responsiveness of that click and buzz is EXTREMELY inconsistent and is quite irritating. Depending on how I’m wearing it there are numerous occasions where pendant is DISCONNECTED or offline and I miss critical data. I see there are a lot of complaints about disconnections… [...] - Not having PLAYABLE, USABLE, AUDIO for all recordings, to recall on demand, is a big one. Again, Limitless set that bar very high. I do have, and pay for the Google Drive audio backup, but I don’t know how that will even work. I haven’t even tried to listen to it. But having audio within the app, available, searchable (“play the last phone call I had with my brother John”, or “play what the mechanic said about fixing my transmission in June of last year”, etc.) is really an invaluable asset to have. And Limitless HAD THAT. Now with it in Meta’s hands, who knows!! PLEASE WORK ON THIS.
- WISH could substitute the OMI pendant with the Limitless Pendant, but was told it would not integrate and the app will not work. That’s a wish list item… [...] # MY CURRENT EXPERIENCE - GOOD AND BAD

Good:

- Form factor, size and weight acceptable
- Always on, always listening option is ABSOLUTE NECESSITY. Thank you.
- The ecosystem, iOS and MacOS apps, are excellent. And getting better all the time.THANK YOU.

results.title: OMI Customer Service Phone Number 1-877-377-7274, Email, Help Center
results.content:
### 

The OMI customer service email for general questions and concerns is info@omi.co. It can be used to request information about the company’s services, policies, prices, and maintenance. The same email is appropriate for feedback, complaints, and compliments. You can also use this address to get in touch with the tech experts for help with troubleshooting, or bug and system outage reports. The customer care team will consider your comments and email you back, answering your questions or offering ways to resolve the issue as soon as they study your case. Alternatively, you can submit your inquiry via the website by visiting the Contact Us page and filling out a request form.

### [...] ### 

To reach the customer service team via the OMI website, click the Contact tab at the top of the homepage and fill out the online form with the required information and the details of your matter. Click the Submit button, and the customer relations experts will get in touch with you to discuss the details after they study your request. You can also find the customer care phone number on this page if you prefer discussing your issue via phone. To follow the company or DM its customer support via social media, scroll the main page to the Connect with Us section and click the preferred platform’s icon.
